citizen_question: I have 6 acres of land and want to buy a power tiller. Is it too late to apply for Krishi Yantra Anudan Yojana?
resolution: No, it is not too late. Yes, you can still apply. Applications under Krishi Yantra Anudan Yojana are accepted until 2026-09-30 (30 September 2026). With 6 acres you are within the 10-acre limit. Get a quotation from a dealer on the department's approved list and bring it with your land record (khatauni) and bank passbook to any service centre. The subsidy is 50% of the price, up to ₹50,000. Buy the machine only after you get the approval letter.
